map.从右往左（含末位校验位），偶数位乘 2，若≥10 则减 9（或各位相加）；所有数: From right to left (including the last check digit), double the even-position digits, subtract 9 if ≥10 (or add the digits); sum all digits; divisible by 10 means valid. It catches single-digit errors and most adjacent transpositions, but does not validate card authenticity.
map.通过 Luhn 仅说明号码符合校验位规则，不代表卡真实存在或有额度；真正扣款需发: Passing Luhn only means the number fits the check-digit rule; it does not mean the card really exists or has credit; actual charging needs issuer authorization.
map.能检出所有单位数错误和约 90% 的相邻数字换位错误，是最低成本的格式校验；但故: It detects all single-digit errors and about 90% of adjacent transpositions — the lowest-cost format check; but deliberately forged compliant numbers also pass, needing back-end verification.
map.为什么卡号有校验位？: Why do card numbers have a check digit?
map.在磁条/手输时代快速拦截录入错误，减少无效交易请求；是现代卡号的标准设计（ISO: To quickly block entry errors in the magnetic-stripe / manual era and cut invalid transaction requests; it is the standard design of modern card numbers (ISO/IEC 7812).
